label: Diagram 1
caption: Diagram 1 | Scope of Part P Notifiable work
description: A schematic drawing titled "Diagram 1 Scope of Part P", headed top-left "See paragraphs 2.2 to 2.4" and footed "Reproduced with the permission of the Electrical Contractors' Association". It shows four building outlines and a legend. The first outline is divided into "Loft", "Dwelling" and "Business unit", each marked with a green tick and an incoming arrow, with a crossed-out symbol and a meter symbol at the base. The second outline has "Roof space" and "Dwelling" ticks, a crossed-out symbol and a meter at its base, plus an external "Business unit" box bearing a crossed-out symbol and a meter. The third outline has "Loft" and "Dwelling" ticks, a crossed-out symbol and a meter at its base, and lines running to external boxes "Garden electrics" and "Out-building", both ticked. The right outline, headed "Roof space" with a green tick, stacks "Dwellings" entries and "Shared facilities such as laundries, kitchens and gymnasiums", all ticked with meters, plus a crossed-out "Business unit"; side labels read "Common access" (ticked) and "Lifts" (crossed out). The legend defines the crossed-out symbol as "Intake switchgear", a flag as "Source of electricity supply", and an M-in-circle as "Electricity supply meter".
